3.name: Dazzling Footwork
3.notes:
Benefits apply only while not wearing armor or wielding a Shield.

• **Dance Virtuoso** — You have Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks involving dancing.
• **Unarmored Defense** — AC = 10 + your Dexterity modifier + your Charisma modifier.
• **Agile Strikes** — Whenever you expend a use of Bardic Inspiration as part of an action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, you can make one Unarmed Strike as part of that same action.
• **Bardic Damage** — You may use Dexterity for Unarmed Strike attack rolls. When dealing damage with an Unarmed Strike, you may deal Bludgeoning damage equal to a roll of your Bardic Inspiration die + your Dexterity modifier instead of normal damage. This does not expend the die.

6.name: Inspiring Movement
6.notes:
When an enemy ends its turn within 5 feet of you, you can take a Reaction and expend a Bardic Inspiration use to move up to half your Speed. Then an ally within 30 feet who can see or hear you may also move up to half their Speed using their Reaction.

This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

6.name: Tandem Footwork
6.notes: When rolling Initiative, you may expend a Bardic Inspiration use (unless Incapacitated). Roll your Bardic Inspiration die; you and all allies within 30 feet who can see or hear you gain an Initiative bonus equal to the number rolled.

14.name: Leading Evasion
14.notes:
When subjected to an effect requiring a Dexterity saving throw for half damage, you take no damage on a success and half on a failure.
If creatures within 5 feet of you make the same save, you can share this benefit with them. You cannot use this feature while Incapacitated.
